title: Senior Manager of Operations
text:
**Senior Manager of Operations - Austin, TX**

**DESCRIPTION:**

We’re seeking a hands-on Sr. Operations Manager with experience scaling silicon-based products in a semiconductor company. This player-coach role owns the operational path from foundry and wafer production through test, backend processing, and manufacturing. You’ll qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, establish and strengthen quality-control measures, and drive consistent quality, yield, cost, and delivery as production grows.

Experience with RFID inlay production is especially relevant.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own foundry relationships from negotiation through production execution, and scale wafer level production.
* Manage wafer-test facility relationships; evaluate and qualify test partners, and select test equipment to optimize cost, quality, and throughput.
* Lead test development, wafer backend operations, yield improvement, reliability, and failure analysis.
* Qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, including overseeing end-to-end inlay production and its ramp to volume.
* Establish and improve quality-control measures, operating procedures, and RMA processes.
* Monitor supplier quality, conduct supply-chain audits, and resolve manufacturing, quality, and delivery issues.
* Establish and improve ERP/MRP processes, WIP tracking, inventory planning, and production controls.
* Develop cost models, negotiate contracts, and drive improvements in cost, quality, and delivery.
* Manage one direct report and coordinate work across four internal engineers and executive stakeholders, including the CEO.

**What you’ll bring:**

* BSEE or equivalent practical experience.
* 7–10 years of operations, manufacturing, or related experience in a semiconductor company.
* Experience with RFID inlay manufacturing is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with silicon-based products and semiconductor manufacturing operations.
* Experience scaling products from wafer fabrication and test through backend processing and volume production.
* Experience working with foundries, wafer-test facilities, and manufacturing vendors.
* Familiarity with yield optimization, reliability, quality assurance, supplier audits, failure analysis, ERP/MRP systems, WIP tracking, and inventory planning.
* Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, with a practical, roll-up-your sleeves approach.
